result.description: Merchant-of-Record payments platform for creators/sellers (checkout, subscriptions, refunds); rebranded to Commas in July 2026.
result.auth_detail: Static seller API key in the x-api-key header. Keys carry per-resource scopes (e.g. refunds, payments, customers, webhooks). Separate production and sandbox keys. No OAuth.
result.access_detail: Seller creates a key in the dashboard under Account → API Keys, and can create sandbox keys in a separate sandbox dashboard. I found no plan gating or approval step, but the docs don't state pricing or eligibility. Rate limits vary by account; one update mentions 10,000 requests per hour. Production use needs a seller account, which the docs don't describe in detail. The official docs site (fanbasis.com/docs) returned 403 to my fetchers, so I read a Netlify-hosted copy (fbnewapi.netlify.app) that a third-party GitHub repo links to as live docs. Treat it as unverified against the official site.
result.api_notes: Base URL https://www.fanbasis.com/public-api (sandbox https://qa.dev-fan-basis.com). Resources: checkout sessions (plus embedded checkout), customers (including charging saved cards), subscribers and subscriptions (including proration), discount codes, products, transactions, refunds and disputes. Also webhooks (13 event types, signed), an npm @fanbasis/checkout-sdk, and a sandbox environment.

evidence.quote: All requests require an API key in the `x-api-key` header:
Each environment needs its own API key registered against your account — a production key will not work in sandbox, and vice versa.
